title: Concept: Possible a GnuPG passphrase passed on the command line in source
description: a GnuPG passphrase passed on the command line places a credential directly in a tool invocation. The value then propagates through build logs, image layers and copied commands, so it must be treated as exposed the moment it is committed.
applicability: Scripts, Makefiles, CI definitions and runbooks that may contain a GnuPG passphrase passed on the command line.
risk: Use of the credential through the tool it was meant for, by anyone who reads the script or the log; HIGH severity.
